PLAN "12-Week Cycle-Adjusted Strength Program for Dysmenorrhea Consideration"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "12-week cycle-adjusted strength progression with flow-day modifications"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Week 1 - Flow safe start":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
          lat_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Week 1 - Midweek accessory + flow awareness":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
          hip_flexor_stretch 1.5 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 40m "Week 1 - Push/Pull + core":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          trunk_stretch 2 minutes
  WEEK 2:
    DAY Monday training 45m "Week 2 - Progressive load (flow-safe)":
      warmup:
        walking 5 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        squat 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        bench_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        barbell_row 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
      cooldown:
        hamstring_stretch 2 minutes
        thoracic_opening 1.5 minutes
    DAY Wednesday training 40m "Week 2 - Accessory + stability":
      warmup:
        jog_in_place 3 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        seated_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
      cooldown:
        upper_back_stretch 2 minutes
    DAY Friday training 40m "Week 2 - Core & tempo pulls":
      warmup:
        cycling 4 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
      cooldown:
        glute_stretch 2 minutes
  WEEK 3:
    DAY Monday training 45m "Week 3 - Moderate volume":
      warmup:
        walking 5 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
      cooldown:
        hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
        spinal_twist 1.5 minutes
    DAY Wednesday training 40m "Week 3 - Mobility + control":
      warmup:
        march_in_place 3 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
      cooldown:
        chest_stretch 2 minutes
    DAY Friday training 40m "Week 3 - Pull focus + core":
      warmup:
        jog_in_place 3 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        tricep_pushdown 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
      cooldown:
        abdominal_wrap 2 minutes
  WEEK 4:
    DAY Monday training 45m "Week 4 - Deload readiness":
      warmup:
        walking 5 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        squat 3x5..7 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        bench_press 3x5..7 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        barbell_row 3x5..7 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
      cooldown:
        full_body_stretch 3 minutes
    DAY Wednesday training 40m "Week 4 - Mobility + light":
      warmup:
        cycling 4 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        goblet_squat 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        shoulder_press 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        lat_pulldown 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
      cooldown:
        hip_groin_stretch 2 minutes
    DAY Friday training 40m "Week 4 - Core & posture":
      warmup:
        jumping_jack 2 minutes
      main straight_sets:
        incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
      cooldown:
        lower_back_stretch 2 minutes

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Phase 2 Week 1 - Flow-day accommodation":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_stretch 2 minutes
      NOTE: On cycle days 1-3, reduce volume by ~20% and substitute lower-impact movements; keep intensity RPE 7-8 where possible but avoid Valsalva-heavy lifts.
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Phase 2 Week 1 - Flow-safe accessories":
        warmup:
          cycling 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_mobility 2 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 40m "Phase 2 Week 1 - Core + upper pull":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          press_variation: shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lateral_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Phase 2 Week 2 - progressive load":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Phase 2 Week 2 - accessories":
        warmup:
          cycling 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 40m "Phase 2 Week 2 - core + pulls":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Phase 2 Week 3 - volume progression":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Phase 2 Week 3 - mobility + light":
        warmup:
          cycling 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_opening 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 40m "Phase 2 Week 3 - core + pulls":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          abdominal_wrap 2 minutes
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Phase 2 Week 4 - deload + stability":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5..7 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x5..7 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x5..7 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 3 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Phase 2 Week 4 - flow-aware mobility":
        warmup:
          cycling 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          shoulder_press 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_groin_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 40m "Phase 2 Week 4 - core & posture":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lower_back_stretch 2 minutes

Notes:
- Cycle-aware adjustments: On days that fall within cycle days 1–3, substitute or reduce high-impact or high-intensity work and avoid heavy Valsalva lifts. Maintain overall weekly progression via volume modulation and tempo control.
- Flow days: If symptoms are significant, swap to only essential lifts and reduce volume by approximately 30–40% from the planned sets/reps for that session, focusing on technique, breathing, and non-load bearing control.
- Intensity guidance: RPE targets intended to reflect effort relative to given sets; if client reports dysmenorrhea-related limitation, favor RPE 6–7 on affected days and revert toward 7–8 when flow subsides.
- Progression: Week-to-week increases are conservative to accommodate cycle variability. If client tolerates, add 1 small progression set (e.g., 4th set) at Week 3 of each phase for main compounds, while maintaining flow-day accommodations.

Restrictions:
- Exclude any high jump, heavy heavy Valsalva, or plyometrics during cycle day 1–3.
- All exercises adhere to canonical vocabulary.
